transcript.text: my washin mashine wont turn on at all no lights nothin
From what you have described, the most likely cause is property socket / supply / switched fused spur. Can you tell me whether recently moved home or the machine recently moved/installed?
no i havent moved, it came with the flat. it worked 2 days ago and then this morning its just dead
From what you have described, the most likely cause is power cord / plug / lead seated and undamaged. Can you tell me whether vibration can work the plug loose from the socket over time?
idk about the plug, its behind the machine and i cant reach it, its built in behind a cupboard door. the kettle and fridge still work tho

Right, so we know the socket works for other things, but the plug itself is hard to check. Because the machine is completely dead (no lights at all), it's probably an issue with the power getting into the machine. 1. 2. The internal mains filter (the first component inside the machine that takes the electricity) has failed.
3. Less commonly, the main control board's power supply section has failed. 1. Confirm the socket: Plug a lamp or phone charger into that same socket to be 100% sure it's live.
2. Check for a spur switch: Look around the wall near the machine. Is there a small switched outlet (a white box with a red switch) controlling just this appliance? Sometimes these get knocked off. If the socket is most likely live and there's no spur switch, we'll need to look inside the machine at the back of the panel where the cable enters. Are you comfortable removing the two screws on the back cover to check for loose wires or a burnt smell?

ok i looked and theres a row of switches above the worktop, one says 'washer' and its OFF. my flatmate must have switched it off when cleaning. i dont have any tools so i cant do the screws anyway, should i flick it on?

Yes, please flick that 'washer' switch to ON. That is the dedicated power supply for your machine (a switched fused spur), and since it was OFF, no electricity could get in—that explains why there are no lights or response at all. Once you've turned it on:
1. Try starting a normal wash cycle.
2. If it works, that's the fix. Just keep an eye on it for the first few minutes to make sure it runs normally.
3. If it still doesn't turn on (no lights), then we know there is likely an internal fault with the machine itself (such as a failed mains filter or control board) and you will need to call an engineer, as that requires opening the casing which isn't safe without tools and training.
i flicked it on and the machine lights up now and works! thanks
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
